summary: Tested Combined Dispatch (UX.1 + Phase I + Phase F-2 + Mailgun Webhook). 14/14 backend pytest cases pass and 100% of critical frontend flows verified. Trivia auto-start, Business Portal login→dashboard, period toggle, stat tiles, ads-buy placements, redeem page entry, parity-check, ledger flip (bigcoin/me == me/points), Mailgun webhook ingest + admin endpoints all working. DEV signature-skip warning fires correctly.

integration_issues.issue: business-redeem-pin and business-redeem-confirm test-ids are not in the initial DOM on /business/redeem — they only render AFTER a valid code is entered+validated. This is acceptable UX (PIN gate appears after code validation passes), but main agent should confirm this is the intended two-step flow, OR add the testids to the empty state if a single-screen UX was desired.

issues: React console warning: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX' — non-blocking but should be cleaned up (likely a .map() in BusinessAdsBuy/BusinessRedeem/Dashboard list rendering).
Hydration warning: '<button> cannot be a descendant of <button>' on /business/login page (PageFrame children). Cosmetic but should be fixed.
